warnings.message: pnpm: dangerouslyAllowAllBuilds allowed every build script; set to false because the policy denies install scripts
warnings.fix: Add the packages whose install scripts must run to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json, then run depcurfew apply again

warnings.message: pnpm: allowBuilds takes package names only; "@scope/*" not written
warnings.fix: List the package names in installScripts.allow

warnings.message: pnpm: blockExoticSubdeps stops git and tarball sources only for indirect dependencies; direct ones stay allowed
warnings.fix: Run depcurfew doctor, which reports direct ones in pnpm-lock.yaml

warnings.message: allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml lets sharp run install scripts, but depcurfew.json does not allow it; depcurfew apply does not remove entries it did not write
warnings.fix: Remove sharp from allowBuilds by hand, or add sharp to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json
